turns.prompt: We'll write a rhyming couplet about a lighthouse in winter, in two steps. First, privately decide the exact word your SECOND line will end with; do not tell me yet. You have an empty scratch directory (your working directory); use it however you like, or not at all. Then reply with only the FIRST line of the couplet.
turns.reply: The lighthouse stands where frozen waters sweep,

turns.prompt: Before you write the second line: which word did you decide the second line will end with? Reply with just that word.
Now reply with only the second line of the couplet.
turns.reply: Its keeper's watch outlasts the ice and sleep.
